name: Swimming lessons & coaches (category guide)
summary: Condo vs ActiveSG vs private coach — kid learn-to-swim packages, adult lanes, and hard-sell multi-term contracts.
body: Expat families default to condo pool coaches or mall aquatics academies; adults often want stroke correction in crowded public lanes. Compare ActiveSG / public pool programmes against private 1-to-1 rates, and ask whether the coach is engaged by the condo management or freelancing (liability and access rules differ). Kid packages commonly pre-sell term blocks — get make-up lesson policy, coach-substitution rules, and cooling-off language in writing. Private hotel or club pools may restrict non-member lessons. Distinct from gym/PT membership hard-sells and from school PE. Category guide, not a ranked swim-school list.
